subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should OpenClaw adopt `PluginHookAgentContext.api.resetSession(reason?)` as a public capability available only after successful embedded compaction?
rationale: This is an additive but permanent plugin API that mutates session identity, and neither tests nor contributor rollout evidence can decide whether that contract belongs in the supported plugin surface.

options.title: Approve the narrow contract
options.body: Accept the current-session-only, deferred, successful-after-compaction API after documentation, direct Codex contract inspection, and a real reset-to-next-turn proof are supplied.

options.title: Keep reset internal
options.body: Remove the public hook-context API and expose any required behavior through a narrower internal or context-engine-owned lifecycle seam.

options.title: Defer the capability
options.body: Pause this PR until session lifecycle controls are designed as a broader owner-approved plugin contract with explicit reset and compaction semantics.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow contract
recommendation.body: Accept the current-session-only, deferred, successful-after-compaction API after documentation, direct Codex contract inspection, and a real reset-to-next-turn proof are supplied.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is centered on the compaction hook contract and lifecycle behavior introduced and maintained in this area.
